user_story: As a user, I want to be prevented from registering with an already-used email so that duplicate accounts are avoided.

positive.title: Register with a unique email
steps: Fill in the registration form with a unique email address and valid details.
positive.expected_result: The registration is successful, and the user is redirected to the welcome page.

negative.title: Register with an already-used email
steps: Fill in the registration form with an email address that is already registered.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the email is already in use and the registration is prevented.

edge.title: Register with email containing unusual characters
steps: Fill in the registration form with an email address containing unusual but valid characters (e.g., test+1@example.com).
edge.expected_result: The registration is successful if the email is unique, as unusual characters are legitimate in emails.
